summary: iter-158 super-admin impersonation + platform-wallet top-up (mock path). Backend 5/5 pytest passed; Frontend 12/13 UI steps passed. Full end-to-end verified: Super Admin (phone 9970705391) logs in as role=admin, opens /super-admin/messes, sees 4 seeded mess rows, clicks 'Act as' on first mess → success toast 'Acting as Auto Gen' fires and navigates to /mess-owner/settings. WalletTopUpCard renders, shows current balance (₹500 before), all 4 quick-amount chips (₹500/1000/5000/10000) correctly update the amount input, and clicking 'Top up' with 500 successfully calls topup-order → auto-verifies via topup-verify (mock path) → balance increments to ₹1000 (+₹500 credited).
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: topup-verify for real (non-mock) Razorpay orders with an EMPTY signature still credits the wallet (the check `if not order.get('mock') and payload.signature` skips signature-verification when signature is empty). Anyone knowing an order_id could POST without signature and be credited. Fix: reject non-mock orders lacking signature (or always require signature when order is non-mock).

In `_resolve_current_mess` for admin without impersonation, it falls back to DEFAULT_MESS_ID (`efoodcare-amravati`). An unimpersonated admin hitting /platform-wallet/topup-order still credits the default mess. Consider requiring impersonation for wallet writes to avoid accidental cross-mess credits.
OTP send is rate-limited to once per 10 min per phone which makes E2E automation harder; consider allowing dev_mode to bypass or shorter window in non-prod.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13) — the one 'fail' was only that the toast text was empty when captured 6s after the click; the wallet balance did increment correctly (₹500 → ₹1000), so the flow works. The toast likely faded before capture.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is stable at /app/backend/tests/test_iter158_impersonate_wallet.py — caches admin token in /tmp/iter158_tokens.json to avoid rate-limits across runs. For UI: OTP is rate-limited to once per 10 min per phone, so best strategy is to authenticate via curl (POST /api/auth/verify-otp captures Set-Cookie: session_token=sess_xxx) then inject that cookie via page.context.add_cookies before navigating to /super-admin/messes. Toast timing: sonner toasts fade after ~4s, so if you need to assert toast text, capture immediately after click, not after long waits.
